searchText: Sir, how can I join the test as a node? To be strict this would deviate from what the spec says. But I don't see any practical issue that can occur as you will change this to the merge block number in the future. We may re-use difficulty field at some point in time in one of the future hard forks Instructions are here https://kintsugi.themerge.dev/#how-to-join <@654267572107083777> 👍 I want to try it too
